feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Israel orders closure of West Bank after soldiers kill 2 men behind an alleged attack
entry.summary: Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people were injured, including some critically.

entry.title: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70 percent of websites
entry.summary: Governments around the world are rushing to implement safety measures after AI technology found 'severe' vulnerabilities in a key programming language called PHP.

entry.title: What if you gave yourself a day to cancel all the plans you dread?
entry.summary: It's a day to think about all the upcoming appointments and commitments you're dreading — and then decline some of them. Writer Caroline Sylge shares a suggested schedule for the day.

entry.title: Amid Trump's assaults on DEI, how one university is elevating Black students
entry.summary: As many colleges roll back or eliminate such programs, Sacramento State has expanded its offerings for students of color.

entry.title: With jet fuel prices near a record, holiday airfares soar higher
entry.summary: If you're planning to fly this holiday season, be prepared to pay more than you did last year. The price of jet fuel — one of airlines' biggest expenses — is close to an all-time high in the U.S.

entry.title: After nearly 6 years, ex-Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi's son hears her voice
entry.summary: Kim Aris tells NPR his mother sounds strong but is in pain. He says she is held at a residence in the capital.

entry.title: Brazil's runoff: Lula's legacy vs. Bolsonaro's dynasty
entry.summary: Brazil's tight presidential runoff pits a political giant against a Bolsonaro heir in a battle over the country's political future.

entry.title: Gen Z is 'in the thick' of high housing costs. These candidates aim to solve it
entry.summary: Young candidates who rent or live with parents say their generation is "in the thick" of the country's housing affordability crisis. They argue this gives them new energy to solve it for everyone.

entry.title: Europe's heat claims 50,000 lives. Climate change blamed for two-thirds of deaths
entry.summary: Blistering record heat in Europe this summer helped kill more than 50,000 people, with nearly two-thirds of that death toll blamed on human-caused climate change, a new study found.

entry.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died
entry.summary: Skerritt was Captain Dallas in Alien, Viper in Top Gun, and a small town sheriff in the TV series Picket Fences.
